newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sega, Hyundai to form game venture in Seoul -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Sega, Hyundai to form game venture in Seoul -- paper.

text.p: Sega Enterprises ltd and South Korea's Hyundai Group plan to set up a joint venture in Seoul to sell arcade game equipment, a Japanese newspaper reported on Monday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun financial daily reported that the new company will import both finished products and components for local assembly from Japan. The company, to be capitalised at 690 million yen, will be owned 75 percent by Hyundai and 25 percent by Sega, the newspaper said.
The joint venture, due to start in January 1997, is hoping for annual sales of 2.5 billion yen in the first year and 10 billion yen by 2000, it said.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
